title: Corrigendum to "Ramification of multiple eigenvalues for the Dirichlet-Laplacian in perforated domains" published in Journal of Functional Analysis 283 (2022) 109718
summary: We fix the proof of Theorem 1.17 in the quoted reference, which does not in general gives the correct coefficients in the asymptotic behavior of eigenvalues for the Dirichlet Laplacian when a small hole is removed from the domain.
